scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n functions,emulators,web -c yellow,cyan,blue "pnpm --filter @tinhome/functions build:watch" "pnpm emulators" "pnpm --filter @tinhome/web dev"
scripts.emulators: pnpm --filter @tinhome/functions build && pnpm exec firebase emulators:start --project demo-tinhome
scripts.test:rules: pnpm exec firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage --project demo-tinhome "pnpm --filter @tinhome/rules-tests test"
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm --filter @tinhome/functions build && pnpm exec firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,storage,functions --project demo-tinhome "pnpm seed && pnpm --filter @tinhome/e2e test"
scripts.test:int: pnpm exec firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,storage --project demo-tinhome "pnpm --filter @tinhome/functions test:int"
